description.value:
Thousand Birds. You channel a screaming, lightning-laced thrust into your dominant hand. As part of casting this jutsu, Stride up to your Speed in a straight line toward a creature you can see, then make a melee spell attack at the end of your Stride.

On a hit, the target takes 5d12 piercing damage plus 2d6 persistent electricity damage. On a critical hit, the target also becomes off-guard until the end of their next turn from the thunderclap.

Chidori commits you to a straight-line charge: if you would change direction during the Stride, you must succeed at a DC 20 Reflex save or lose the attack and become off-guard for 1 round (the canonical 'beak of the chicken' tunnel vision).

Heightened (+1) Damage increases by 1d12 and persistent electricity by 1d6.
